ectool: Add separate USE flag for ectool In order to support systems without ectool we need a flag that explicitly indicates whether or not it should be present. To do this I split out the ectool build/install process and only call those functions if the USE flag is enabled. By default this flag is true, and it is disabled only on systems that do not use the Chromium EC. The new flag is also used by the initramfs ebuild to provide an indication to the initramfs build system so it can include ectool only if it is present instead of always expecting it to exist.
